Gains and losses of each clique on the species tree

Source: R/edge_history.R
edge_history.Rd

Reads clique presence over species as a binary character. Fitch parsimony on a rooted species tree places each gain and loss on a branch. A second table sums the changes per branch.

Usage

edge_history(cliques, tree, species)

Arguments

cliques

A classify_gene_cliques() table. It needs clique_id, hog, missing_species and missing_reason. run is kept.

tree

A rooted phylo from the ape package, with tips named by species.

species

Every species of the analysis. Each must be a tip.

Value

A list of two data frames. cliques has one row per input row, in input order: n_present, n_absent (state 0), n_unknown, state_root, root_tied, n_gain, n_loss, n_mpr, and the branches in gains and losses. branches has one row per branch, named by the node below it as in clades_from_tree(): n_species, and n_gain and n_loss summed over the cliques.

Details

A member species has state 1. A species with reason tested_ns has state 0: the pair was tested and failed. Every other reason is unknown (?), and so is a tip outside species. An unknown tip never counts as a change. An absent species is unknown because gene presence is its own character, and a gene loss is not a co-expression loss.

The pass is unit-cost Fitch, run once per distinct pattern of missing species. The tree may hold polytomies. A clique restricted to one clade costs the same as one gain on its stem or one loss outside it. Such a root tie resolves to absent, so the clique reads as one gain, as lineage_specific does. root_tied flags the tie. Below the root, a tie takes the change as early as possible (ACCTRAN). n_mpr counts the equally parsimonious reconstructions.

Examples

if (requireNamespace("ape", quietly = TRUE)) {
  tree <- ape::read.tree(text = "((A,B),(C,D));")
  cl <- data.frame(
    clique_id = c("1", "2"), hog = "H1",
    missing_species = c("C,D", "D"),
    missing_reason = c("tested_ns,tested_ns", "tested_ns")
  )
  edge_history(cl, tree, c("A", "B", "C", "D"))
}
#> $cliques
#>   clique_id hog n_present n_absent n_unknown state_root root_tied n_gain n_loss
#> 1         1  H1         2        2         0          0      TRUE      1      0
#> 2         2  H1         3        1         0          1     FALSE      0      1
#>   n_mpr gains losses
#> 1     2 node6       
#> 2     1            D
#> 
#> $branches
#>   branch n_species n_gain n_loss
#> 1      A         1      0      0
#> 2      B         1      0      0
#> 3      C         1      0      0
#> 4      D         1      0      1
#> 5  node6         2      1      0
#> 6  node7         2      0      0
#>
